metadata.title: Berkshire Hathaway (BRK.B) Stock Forecast: Buffett’s 96th Birthday and Abel’s Outlook<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Warren Buffett Turns 96 on Sunday. His Final Berkshire Masterpiece Isn’t Winning Over Wall Street.
Warren Buffett is getting high marks for his role as Berkshire Hathaway’s chairman as he approaches his 96th birthday on Sunday.
